messages:
zoe.new: Hi all — day 1. Couple setup snags: Okta push notifications never arrive on my phone and when I accepted the 1Password invite it landed in my personal inbox (ugh). Also tried scanning the QR for TOTP and it says 'Invalid QR'. Who should I bug?
rahul-it: Welcome! @it-identity for provisioning. For push: did you install Okta Verify or are you using push to Okta Verify? Which phone/os?
zoe.new: Pixel 7, Android 13. I installed Okta Verify and opened the activation link but desktop still shows 'Waiting for push' indefinitely.
it-identity: I see your SCIM record, but your account wasn't in the 'engineering' Google group until just now — that can sometimes delay app provisioning. Pushed a sync. For mobile push, check that Okta Verify has notifications allowed and background data enabled.
maggie-devex: Also try tapping 'I didn't receive a push' and use the QR/TOTP fallback. Did you forward the 1Password invite to personal? We prefer invites accepted on corporate email.
okta-bot: Okta: Activation email sent to zoe@redwood.com at 1795004200.
zoe.new: I accidentally accepted on personal while moving between tabs. Now I revoked that session but I don't see the company invite in work inbox.
onepassword-bot: 1Password: Invite accepted from riley.personal@gmail.com at 1795004300. No corporate acceptance recorded.
rahul-it: I revoked the personal invite and resent to zoe@redwood.com. Also, try clearing app cache for Okta Verify and re-open activation link on the phone.
zoe.new: Did that — app cleared, opened mobile activation link, Okta Verify shows an entry but desktop still waits on push. Phone has notification permission on.
it-identity: Can you try this quick check: on the phone open Settings -> Apps -> Okta Verify -> Battery -> Allow background activity. Also ensure Data Saver is off for the app. Push can fail if background network blocked.
zoe.new: Background activity was off (I had aggressive battery saver). Turned it on and retried — still no push. Desktop shows 'Attempting push (0/3)'.
rahul-it: Two more checks: 1) Are you on corporate VPN on your laptop? Sometimes firewall rules block outbound WebSocket endpoints used for push. 2) Try switching phone to cellular (no Wi-Fi) and reattempt.
zoe.new: I'm on corp VPN. I can disconnect and try. Switching phone to cellular now and disconnecting VPN on laptop...
zoe.new: Push arrived when I disconnected VPN!
it-identity: Thanks — we'll whitelist the Okta push endpoints on the VPN. For now you can use TOTP as backup. Also invite resent to work email, please accept.
zoe.new: Accepted 1Password invite at zoe@redwood.com. Saved recovery codes there. Quick policy Q: where should I note physical YubiKey storage? Is it ok to keep a backup key at my apartment?
maggie-devex: Company policy: primary key should be with you, backup key stored in a secure location (home safe or bank safe deposit). Record the storage location in the company 1Password vault entry under 'MFA Backup' but don’t include pictures or private material.
offtopic-it: small tip: if you ever need to re-register after a push/network issue, regenerate a TOTP secret server-side (we can do that) so you have a clean fallback.
zoe.new: Thanks everyone — fixed and notes saved in 1Password. Closing thread. :tada:
